[Council File 26-0916]
Motion (Price – Rodriguez) relative to the declaration of the City-owned property located adjacent to and west of the corner of 39th Street and Flower Drive, and the City-owned property adjacent to 3947 South Figueroa Street near 3900 South Figueroa Street, as Exempt Surplus Land.
